Vulnerabilities.Title: Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation
Vulnerabilities.Description: A use-after-free vulnerability in the Linux kernel nf_tables subsystem could allow a local attacker to elevate privileges. This affects systems running kernel versions before 5.4.0-43.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Apache HTTP Server Expression Parser
Vulnerabilities.Description: A flaw in the expression parser in Apache HTTP Server could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via specially crafted HTTP requests containing malicious expressions.

Vulnerabilities.Title: OpenSSL HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack
Vulnerabilities.Description: The HTTP/2 protocol allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service by sending rapid requests and resets. This vulnerability affects OpenSSL implementations of HTTP/2.

Vulnerabilities.Title: curl HTTP Header Injection
Vulnerabilities.Description: A vulnerability in curl before 8.1.0 allows injection of arbitrary HTTP headers by sending specially crafted URLs. This could lead to cache poisoning or session hijacking attacks.

Vulnerabilities.Title: glibc fopen Memory Disclosure
Vulnerabilities.Description: A memory disclosure vulnerability in glibc could allow local attackers to read sensitive information from process memory when using fopen() function with specific parameters.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Requests Library SSRF Vulnerability
Vulnerabilities.Description: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in requests library could allow attackers to make unauthorized HTTP requests to internal services when processing user-supplied URLs.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Django SQL Injection in ORM
Vulnerabilities.Description: A SQL injection vulnerability in Django ORM could allow attackers to inject arbitrary SQL code through specially crafted filter arguments, potentially leading to unauthorized database access.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Jinja2 Template Injection
Vulnerabilities.Description: A server-side template injection vulnerability in Jinja2 could allow remote code execution when user input is not properly sanitized before being passed to templates.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Pillow DOS Vulnerability
Vulnerabilities.Description: A denial of service vulnerability in Pillow image processing library could be triggered by processing specially crafted image files, causing excessive CPU or memory usage.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Werkzeug Path Traversal
Vulnerabilities.Description: A path traversal vulnerability in Werkzeug could allow attackers to access files outside the intended directory when serving static files with improper path validation.
